decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The noise generated from any of the woodworking machines, any extraction plant and any other plant used within and/or attached to the proposed new building, should be inaudible when assessed from the nearest noise sensitive receptor.
Condition : 4 - Any door or window capable of being opened which is fitted to the proposed new building, should be kept closed during operational hours.
Condition : 5 - The scheme of sound insulation shown on the approved drawings shall be carried out before any part of the development hereby permitted is occupied.
Condition : 6 - The scheme of extract ventilation shown on the approved drawings shall be carried out before any part of the development hereby permitted is occupied.
Condition : 7 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours o  8.00am  to 6.00pm  on Mondays to Friday and 8.00am  to  1.00pm  on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 9 - The uses hereby permitted for shall not be carried on outside the following times: 8am -7pm Monday to Saturday and not at all on Sunday.
description: Erection of side and rear extensions to provide B1 offices ancillary to existing workshop
